venues.name: D&C DC
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Friday 3/13.** Garden closed. Busy 6-8:30 with heavy foot traffic and reservations; skeleton crew, bar team pushed drinks quickly; hosts balanced the waitlist; most guests seated inside and out by 10pm and all inside by 11:30. Several special occasions with cards and table touches. Kitchen: 13.83% of sales; ton of plates, fingerling potatoes the top seller; James held it down solo when tickets flooded. MOD: Kev / Cory / Josh.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Friday 3/13.** Smooth evening, felt a little light. Strong enthusiasts to start, a Ramos Gin Fizz set the first turn's tone; solid larger parties kept energy high each turn and closed out the last hour. Top sellers: Masari, Year of the Trees, First Time Listener. The original form showed $0 for sales because the Z-report copy was not saved (concern over a Point Bartender opening/closing drawer discrepancy; drawer opened with $89.28 instead of $175); figures here are from Sean's amended thread reply on 3/14 (net $7,650, food $1,156, beverage $6,494, check avg $36, comps $246.36). A man at the bar was asked to leave for being invasive of guests' space (Ellis handled it). Door: first Friday hosting with the new reservation system; committed reservations every turn left no room for walk-in 3/4 tops, investors or industry, especially 8 and 10pm; many late reservations; two 2-top reservations became parties of 7; waitlist died by 12-12:30am; members and friends visited. No-shows: Jodi Lynn 6 (Tock res), Alex Dixie 2; 8 reservations cancelled.
